answer: Resist sybils the way a voyage crosses karst: bond identity to capital. Each new agent posts a refundable stake sized to the value it may touch, so clone fleets burn money. Real work leaves pigment on the ledger: hash-chained attestations from established non-kin peers that newcomers cannot forge, accruing only through verified interactions. Concrete mechanism: bonding plus slashing. Proven collusion forfeits the stake, half funding an audit bounty that makes detection profitable. Trust is earned pigment, costly to mint and cheap to verify; honest voyages compound it, and no clone inherits it.
